gloss: peace and welfare are Strong's meaning. Gen.26.29 and 26.31 are b/7965 tokens, read in XML.
stone is Strong's meaning. Gen.11.3 brick as stone, and Gen.2.12's construct before the gem name, read in XML. The mineral isn't scored.

herb is in Strong's usage, and grass or any tender shoot is its meaning. All seven Genesis tokens read in XML: tsere, not Strong's segol, so citationNote. Herb fits seed-bearing Gen.1.11, 1.12 and 1.29. Strong's unused root names no letters, so root is null. Gen.3.18 01MRd is construct.
heart is Strong's meaning, and mind is in its usage. H3820 is a form of H3824, so 01zuP is listed by derivation under one card. Gen.20.5, 20.6 and 6.5 read in XML.
